props.note: Four sockets take four stones. The north door opens.

rooms.name: The Cross
rooms.hint: Four open rooms. Four elements. The north door wants their stones.

props.note: Hunger finds the hard water. A stone of fire sits free.
Yield thrown. The curtain forgets how to burn.
Rest stands. The shots break. The lane is the only floor that reaches the stone.
Body, spirit, and mind take their seats. The living work stands open.

rooms.name: The Wrought Cross
rooms.hint: Joins already stand. Grow, burn, freeze. A door wants three stones.

props.note: The seed already stands. Send it, or write hunger then breath.
Hunger given breath, then sent. The veil forgets how to sting.
Plant, pool, and seed take their seats. The floor opens.
